source: Shigley 10th ed. Eq. 4-5: phi = T L / (G J); surface displacement r phi
request:
Plan: solid steel shaft along X, clamped at x=0, torque 100 N m about X on the far end.
```python
from build123d import *
from engagent.cad import save
save(Pos(100, 0, 0) * Rot(0, 90, 0) * Cylinder(10, 200))
```
```bash
ea make geometry.py --name shaft
ea analyze last -m steel_generic --fix xmin --moment xmax 100,0,0 --check "torsion.round_shaft T=100 L=200 D=20 E=210000 nu=0.3 -> twist"
```

source: Lame thick-walled cylinder, open ends (axial stress 0): von Mises at the bore
request:
Plan: quarter-free model: full tube along Z, ends free to slide axially (open ends), held against rigid motion by symmetry planes.
```python
from build123d import *
from engagent.cad import save
save(Cylinder(50, 200, align=(Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER, Align.MIN)) - Cylinder(30, 200, align=(Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER, Align.MIN)))
```

```bash
ea make geometry.py --name tube

```
